facts.business: NDA Securities Limited is a SEBI-registered, BSE-listed financial services institution offering stock brokerage, mutual fund distribution, depository participant services, and proprietary trading across India's capital markets.

auditor.name: M/s J M and Associates (Chartered Accountants)

key_risks: Revenue recognition complexity across multiple streams including proprietary trading
Identification of distinct performance obligations in integrated service arrangements
Appropriateness of accounting and presentation of proprietary trading transactions on gross basis
Completeness and accuracy of mutual fund trail commission accruals
Measurement and presentation of income from proprietary trading including valuation of closing inventory
Identification, authorisation and disclosure of related party transactions
facts.related_party_note: Key audit matter identified regarding identification, authorisation and disclosure of related party transactions
